description: Add-Car Quote next-step prompts. Editable by business users via Rules Center.

ask_vehicle.zh: 请先发年份和车型，办公室报价前需要这两项。
ask_vehicle.en: Send year and make/model first—the office needs both to quote.

ask_zip.zh: 邮编发我一下，好整理进办公室报价单。
ask_zip.en: Send the zip so we can add it to the office quote file.

ask_delivery_driver.zh: 提车日和主要驾驶人发我，好一并交给办公室报价。
ask_delivery_driver.en: Send the delivery date and main driver so we can hand a complete file to the office.

ask_delivery_only.zh: 提车日期发我一下（或生效日），办公室好安排报价。
ask_delivery_only.en: Send the delivery or effective date so we can line up the quote with the office.

ask_driver_only.zh: 主要驾驶人发我一下，办公室报价前还缺这项。
ask_driver_only.en: Send the main driver—the office still needs that for the quote.
